objective: minimize actual-slicer-estimated filament mass among candidates satisfying all geometry constraints and chosen tip-proxy screen
provenance: Exploratory post-slice sensitivity analysis; guard band chosen for stress testing, not empirically calibrated reliability
unresolved: Slicer mass is estimated extrusion at fixed 1.24g/cm³ density, not scale-measured print mass
Nominal board 25 g is invented illustration, not a measured sample
Tip model is quasistatic lever estimate: not FEA, impulse, slide or fatigue qualification
Guard bands are illustrative sensitivity parameters; reliability confidence is NOT statistically calibrated
PCB fit, ESD, layer adhesion, printer tuning and filament properties are unverified
